map.输入单位风险的理赔频率与平均赔付额，按纯保费 = 频率 × 严重度计算期望损失（: Enter the claim frequency and average claim amount per unit of risk and compute the expected loss (risk premium) with pure premium = frequency x severity, for pure premium estimation in motor and property insurance.
map.纯保费 = 理赔频率 × 平均赔付额。: Pure premium = claim frequency x average claim amount.
map.由出险频率乘案均严重度得纯保费。: Pure premium = claim frequency x average severity.
map.做各业务线纯风险成本对比。: Compare the pure risk cost across business lines.
map.：纯保费 = 0.12×30000 = 3600 元/标的一年。即每标的风险成本: Pure premium = 0.12 x 30000 = 3600 CNY per policy-year. That is, the risk cost per policy is 3600 CNY.
map.纯保费就是该收的保费？: Is Pure Premium What I Should Charge?
map.只是风险成本。实际保费要再加费用率与利润边际，否则承保必亏。: It is only the risk cost. The actual premium adds the expense ratio and the profit margin, otherwise underwriting would always lose money.
map.纯保费为何还要加费用才卖？: Why Does Pure Premium Still Need Loading?
map.纯保费只覆盖期望赔付，不含任何费用与利润。直接按纯保费卖公司必亏。实际保费等于纯: Pure premium covers expected claims only, with no expenses or profit. Selling at pure premium would always lose money. The actual premium equals the pure premium times (1 plus the loading factor) plus a risk margin.
